findings.title: Bind the recorded parent source map to its historical commit
findings.detail: The validator checks source-map completeness, hash shape and self-digest (lines 63-73), then accepts source_commit on 40-hex syntax alone. It never resolves that commit or matches its historical producer bytes to identity.sources. A copied or misattributed schema2 parent receipt can therefore pass the claimed source-bound native-parent route with an unrelated or nonexistent commit. The positive historical-source test explicitly accepts arbitrary source hashes and an arbitrary commit. This is an exact metadata binding gap; the documented inability to prove human-review truth does not require it.
findings.recommendation: For the supported RSD native schema2 route, resolve source_commit in the producer repository and compare historical source bytes against each recorded source hash, failing closed on unavailable or mismatching history while allowing a genuine older source commit to differ from current HEAD. Adapt synthetic tests to explicit mocked historical-source verification rather than treating arbitrary hashes as provenance.

checked_properties: Only one RSD-affecting outgoing commit appears; its complete diff accounts for the current RSD changes.

E0 schema2 inputs require matching scoped native PASS, original checks, full-prefix sampled likelihood, exact producer dependencies and companion containment receipts; process-only PASS is insufficient.
Parent route rejects unfinished, wrong-arm and wrong-experiment metadata and requires positive matching optimizer steps, zero-LoRA exact base, registered runtime and review fields.
Catalog gate binds inputs, source/revision coverage and separate-from-input evidence files; its limitations explicitly preserve attestations as unproved and semantic decontamination false.
Detached KL/backend, engine, checkpoint and quarantine source files are unchanged from the remote base.
Native load/training flags, clean source, live admission and per-arm mechanics gates remain present; no inherited execution permit was found.
Tiny proposal selects seed101, two updates, sft/frozen/evolving, step2 contrasts and defers SRCL.
validation_limits: Static source and Git metadata inspection only; no imports, AST processing, tests, candidate/runtime/native/framework/model/tokenizer/scoring/solver execution.
No protected banks, raw prompts, answers, gold, weight/runtime binaries or arbitrary referenced artifact contents were accessed.
